list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/eil-cmake-utils/cmake)
include(eil_check_idf_features)
eil_check_idf_has_esp_drivers()

# The fonts are compiled from the list in the Kconfig, and every font is a C
# file generated by tools/pixelfont.py. The names in the list are the file
# names without the "font_" prefix and the ".c" suffix.
if(CONFIG_PIXELFONT_FONTS)
    string(REPLACE "," ";" pixelfont_fonts "${CONFIG_PIXELFONT_FONTS}")
else()
    set(pixelfont_fonts)
endif()

set(pixelfont_font_srcs)
set(pixelfont_font_defs)

foreach(font ${pixelfont_fonts})
    string(STRIP "${font}" font)
    if(NOT font STREQUAL "")
        set(src "fonts/font_${font}.c")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${src}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "The font '${font}' is not bundled with pixelfont: "
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${src} does not exist. "
                "Generate it with tools/pixelfont.py or fix "
                "CONFIG_PIXELFONT_FONTS.")
        endif()

        list(APPEND pixelfont_font_srcs ${src})

        string(TOUPPER "${font}" font_upper)
        string(REPLACE "-" "_" font_upper "${font_upper}")
        list(APPEND pixelfont_font_defs "PIXELFONT_FONT_${font_upper}_ENABLED=1")
    endif()
endforeach()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS pixelfont.c pixelfont_load.c ${pixelfont_font_srcs}
    INCLUDE_DIRS . "fonts"
    PRIV_REQUIRES freertos log
)

if(pixelfont_font_defs)
    target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC ${pixelfont_font_defs})
endif()

include(eil_ci)
